settings.title: Settings

settings.sharedLibraryLabel: Share my wardrobe in the common library
settings.sharedLibraryDesc: Your pieces (brand, price, tags, photo) become searchable by other members, anonymously — nobody can see they are yours. Turning it off removes them from future searches, but pieces others already imported stay in their own closet.
settings.sharingWhatIsSharedDesc: Only the product side of each piece: brand, category, colours, materials, tags, size, price and an anonymous copy of the photo.
settings.sharingWhatIsNeverSharedDesc: Your name, account, city, how often you wear something, when you bought it and where you keep it. The link between a piece and you is replaced by an irreversible code held on the server.
settings.sharingTurningOffDesc: Your pieces disappear from future searches and the anonymous photo copies are deleted. Pieces other members already imported remain in their closet as independent copies — they are not removed.

styleDesc.Minimal: Clean lines, few colors, no clutter — quality over decoration.
styleDesc.Editorial: Fashion-forward, styled like a magazine spread — bold silhouettes and combinations.
styleDesc.Quiet luxury: Understated, high-quality basics with no visible logos.
styleDesc.Parisian: Effortless, timeless French style — trench coats, striped tops, tailored basics.
styleDesc.Street: Casual, urban-inspired — sneakers, oversized fits, streetwear brands.
styleDesc.Romantic: Soft, feminine details — ruffles, florals, flowing fabrics.
styleDesc.Tailored: Structured, fitted pieces — blazers, precise cuts.
styleDesc.Bohemian: Free-spirited, textured, layered — prints, fringe, natural fabrics.
styleDesc.Vintage: Inspired by past decades — retro cuts, patterns and details.
styleDesc.Coastal: Relaxed, breezy, beach-inspired — linen, light colors, natural textures.

profileSetup.shareLibraryDetail: Your pieces — brand, price, tags and photo — become visible and reusable by other members, anonymously: nobody will know they came from you. colorAnalysis.title: Color analysis
colorAnalysis.clearPhotoTruerResult: A clear photo, a truer result.
colorAnalysis.estimateAccuracyHint: This estimate is only as accurate as the photo. Take a moment to set the scene.
colorAnalysis.guideline0: Wear a plain white T-shirt or a neutral white top
colorAnalysis.guideline2: Tie your hair back so your face is fully visible
colorAnalysis.guideline5: Avoid direct sunlight or strong shadows
colorAnalysis.guideline6: Stand in front of a neutral white or light-colored background
colorAnalysis.guideline9: Do not use filters or beauty effects
colorAnalysis.guideline10: Use the highest photo quality available
colorAnalysis.tapSkin: Tap a spot on your skin (cheek or forehead)
colorAnalysis.tapHair: Tap a strand of your hair
colorAnalysis.tapEyes: Tap the iris of one eye
colorAnalysis.tapSwatchToRetake: Tap a swatch to retake it
colorAnalysis.lowConfidenceHint: Your top seasons are close — this reading is more uncertain than usual.
colorAnalysis.moderateConfidenceHint: A reasonably clear match, with some overlap with neighboring seasons.
colorAnalysis.sampleQualityHint: The extracted samples also looked less clean than ideal — retaking in even, natural light may help.
colorAnalysis.lessHarmoniousHint: Not off-limits — armocromia is a guide, not a rule. These just need a bit more care: worn away from the face, mixed with a color that suits you, or as a shoe, bag, or pattern accent.
colorAnalysis.couldntDetectFace: Couldn't detect your face automatically. Tap the three points manually.
